module_summary: AXI DMA: an AXI-lite register bank programs src/dst/len and start; a busy controller issues AXI4 read bursts into a byte-realigning FIFO and drains it as boundary-aware AXI4 write bursts, signalling done by interrupt.

anchors.name: r_busy
anchors.why: Idle/busy transfer state; set by start, cleared on last write ack or done; gates all engines

anchors.name: w_start
anchors.why: Decoded start-bit write to control register, launches transfer when not busy or errored

anchors.name: r_err
anchors.why: Sticky bus-error flag from BRESP/RRESP; blocks new bursts and forces done

anchors.name: r_abort
anchors.why: Abort flag set by ABORT_KEY write while busy; stops bursts and zeroes write strobes

anchors.name: r_done
anchors.why: Transfer-complete flag once no bursts outstanding; clears busy, resets FIFO, raises interrupt

anchors.name: o_int
anchors.why: Interrupt output pulsed on completion when interrupts enabled

anchors.name: r_int
anchors.why: Sticky interrupt status bit readable in control register

anchors.name: r_int_enable
anchors.why: Interrupt enable bit written via control register, gates o_int

anchors.name: r_src_addr
anchors.why: Programmed source address; seeds read address and read realignment shifts

anchors.name: r_dst_addr
anchors.why: Programmed destination address; seeds write address and write strobes

anchors.name: r_len
anchors.why: Programmed transfer length in bytes; drives read/write length computations

anchors.name: r_qos
anchors.why: QoS field from control register driven onto AR/AW QOS

anchors.name: r_prot
anchors.why: Protection field from control register driven onto AR/AW PROT

anchors.name: zero_len
anchors.why: Flags zero programmed length, suppresses start

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite write accept enable; gates register bank writes and BVALID

anchors.name: axil_read_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite read accept enable; loads RDATA and RVALID

anchors.name: awskd_addr
anchors.why: AXI-lite write register index selecting which config register is written

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RDATA
anchors.why: Register readback mux output of control/status and address/length registers

anchors.name: S_AXIL_BVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite write response valid

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite read data valid

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AXI master read-burst request valid, issued when w_start_read

anchors.name: phantom_read
anchors.why: One-cycle marker of a newly issued read burst; advances read address and counters

anchors.name: w_start_read
anchors.why: Decides issuing a read burst: busy, reads remaining, FIFO space, no error

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Read burst address loaded from read_address

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARLEN
anchors.why: Read burst length from readlen_w

anchors.name: read_address
anchors.why: Next read burst address, advanced by burst length on each issued read

anchors.name: reads_remaining_w
anchors.why: Words still to request; decremented per issued read burst

anchors.name: read_beats_remaining_w
anchors.why: Read data beats still expected; decremented per R beat

anchors.name: read_bursts_outstanding
anchors.why: Outstanding read bursts count; blocks done until zero

anchors.name: no_read_bursts_outstanding
anchors.why: No reads outstanding flag; drives M_AXI_RREADY low

anchors.name: readlen_w
anchors.why: Next read burst length in words, boundary and MAXBURST limited

anchors.name: reads_remaining_nonzero
anchors.why: Indicates more read bursts needed, enables w_start_read

anchors.name: M_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data beat valid; writes realigned data into FIFO

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data from source memory, shifted into realignment FIFO

anchors.name: M_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Read data ready while read bursts outstanding

anchors.name: r_write_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO write enable pushing realigned incoming words

anchors.name: r_read_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO read enable when output word consumed by write channel

anchors.name: fifo_full
anchors.why: FIFO full flag stalls read-side realignment pipeline

anchors.name: fifo_empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty flag gates FIFO reads and partial output word

anchors.name: fifo_space_available
anchors.why: Reserved FIFO space; read bursts issued only if a full burst fits

anchors.name: fifo_data_available
anchors.why: Unreserved FIFO data count; write burst starts when enough data buffered

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.r_realigned_incoming
anchors.why: Read data realigned by source byte offset, written into FIFO

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.r_outword
anchors.why: FIFO output word realigned to destination offset, drives M_AXI_WDATA

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.r_partial_inword
anchors.why: Carries leftover bytes of previous read beat for input realignment

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.r_partial_outword
anchors.why: Carries leftover bytes of previous FIFO word for output realignment

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.inbyte_shift
anchors.why: Source byte offset selecting input shift amount

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.outbyte_shift
anchors.why: Destination byte offset selecting output shift amount

anchors.name: r_partial_in_valid
anchors.why: Partial input word valid; qualifies FIFO writes

anchors.name: r_partial_outvalid
anchors.why: Partial output word valid; controls FIFO reads

anchors.name: clear_read_pipeline
anchors.why: Flushes final partial input word into FIFO after last read beat

anchors.name: extra_realignment_read
anchors.why: Indicates an extra FIFO write needed for unaligned source tail

anchors.name: extra_realignment_write
anchors.why: Indicates an extra output beat needed for unaligned destination tail

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: AXI master write-burst request valid, issued on w_write_start

anchors.name: phantom_write
anchors.why: One-cycle marker of issued write burst; advances write address and counters

anchors.name: w_write_start
anchors.why: Starts a write burst when FIFO holds enough data and channels idle

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Write burst address loaded from write_address

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWLEN
anchors.why: Write burst length from write_burst_length

anchors.name: write_address
anchors.why: Next write burst address, advanced by burst bytes on each issued write

anchors.name: writes_remaining_w
anchors.why: Words still to write; decides burst length, last ack and done

anchors.name: write_bursts_outstanding
anchors.why: Write bursts awaiting B response; gates done and last ack

anchors.name: write_beats_remaining
anchors.why: Remaining write beats, selects last-beat strobe

anchors.name: write_count
anchors.why: Beat counter within current write burst, generates WLAST

anchors.name: write_burst_length
anchors.why: Computed length of next write burst: first, max, or remainder

anchors.name: first_write_burst
anchors.why: Selects boundary-limited first burst length

anchors.name: first_write_len_w
anchors.why: Length of first write burst clipped to burst boundary

anchors.name: multiple_write_bursts_remaining
anchors.why: More than one max burst remaining, chooses MAXBURST length

anchors.name: write_requests_remaining
anchors.why: More write bursts need issuing, enables w_write_start

anchors.name: last_write_ack
anchors.why: Next B response is final; clears busy and raises interrupt

anchors.name: M_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid across burst, started by w_write_start until WLAST

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data to destination from realigned FIFO output

anchors.name: M_AXI_WLAST
anchors.why: Last beat of write burst from write_count

anchors.name: M_AXI_WSTRB
anchors.why: Write byte strobes from first/last strobe masks, zero on error/abort

anchors.name: r_first_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte strobe mask for first unaligned destination word

anchors.name: r_last_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte strobe mask for last destination word

anchors.name: M_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Write data ready; advances beat counters and FIFO reads

anchors.name: M_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid; retires outstanding write bursts

anchors.name: M_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: Write response ready until done

anchors.name: gated_clk
anchors.why: Optional gated core clock, disabled by default parameter

anchors.name: clk_active
anchors.why: Clock-gate activity flag gating AXI-lite accept

groups.name: axil_register_bank
groups.description: AXI-lite skid buffers and register file for control, source, destination and length

groups.name: dma_controller
groups.description: Busy/done control with start decode, error/abort flags and interrupt

groups.name: read_burst_engine
groups.description: Issues boundary-aware AXI4 read bursts from source and tracks outstanding beats

groups.name: realignment_fifo
groups.description: Byte-shifting realignment around sfifo buffering read data for write bursts

groups.name: write_burst_engine
groups.description: Issues AXI4 write bursts when FIFO has data, generates WLAST/WSTRB, retires B responses

groups.name: clock_gating
groups.description: Optional local clock gating active while busy or AXI-lite traffic pending
